eyebrow: The four pillars of real prep
code:
1. Hands-on practice   -> developer.servicenow.com
                          (free Personal Dev Instance)
2. Read the blueprint  -> ServiceNow's own published
                          topic list and weighting
3. Timed practice      -> scenario questions, a real
                          clock, no looking things up
4. Reinforcement       -> organize skills you already
                          built in Courses 1-13
caption: None of these four steps is optional — each covers a gap the others don't.

eyebrow: Reading about it vs. doing it
code:
Reading your Course 8 notes       Opening a PDI and actually
about an Incident lifecycle       walking an incident through
                                   that lifecycle yourself
- recognizes the right phrasing   - hits the same edge cases
- doesn't reveal real gaps          the exam's scenarios do
caption: Exams test whether you can do it, not whether you can recognize it.
